services.desc: Chase The Blue Tarpon charters are available between May through July, Tarpon fishing is not just a sport, it is a passion filled with excitement and challenge for anglers worldwide. These magnificent creatures are renowned for their beauty, size, acrobatic jumps, and impressive fighting abilities, making them a bucket list fish. Tarpon, often referred to as the "Silver King," hold a prestigious status as one of the most sought-after game fish globally. Their sheer power and tenacity make every encounter an unforgettable experience. blurb: Chase the Blue Charters offers fishing trips ranging from inshore to offshore, including specialty trips like red snapper and tarpon charters, as well as customizable sandbar cruises. Trips target various species including red snapper, tarpon, snook, speckled trout, and redfish. The business is locally owned and operated by Captain Devin Calderon, who has extensive experience fishing the waters of Anna Maria Island.

quotes.author: Stephanie B.
quotes.text: Devin, with Chase The Blue Charters in AMI, runs a fantastic operation! He is extremely accommodating and wants you to have the best fishing experience possible. We booked a 6 person, PM nearshore trip and had a great time. Devin knows where to find the fish and we were catching at 1st cast. He makes sure you always have fresh bait on & keeps your hooks & lines ready. Very friendly & personable. If you're looking for a great fishing experience in the AMI area, we highly recommend Devin Calderon (Chase the Blue Charters)!!!

Devon did an amazing job putting us on fish on our inshore fishing charter. A storm was coming in this afternoon and he was great at communicating with us several days before our morning charter and scheduling our morning start time to earlier so we would be back in before the storm hit. We caught snook, speckled trout and red fish. We all had a fantastic time and highly recommend Devon and Chase the Blue Charters! We will definitely use them again on our next Anna Maria Island vacation!

Had a fantastic time today fishing with Captain Devin!! I can’t say enough great things about him! He’s the best and that’s why we’ve gone with him for the past 2 years on spring break. He took my son, father and me on an inshore trip and made sure we were all well taken care of and catching fish!! I highly recommend him and we can’t wait to go out fishing with him next year!! Thanks Devin!!!

We had a great half day, offshore trip with Captain Devin today! He put us on a pile of Mangrove Snapper and we hauled in more than enough for dinner. We also hooked up some gags, red grouper, and a triggerfish. Overall it was great day on the water!

Feb 21, 2024 - Devin was a delightful captain and adventure guide. He found fish, we caught fish, and he truly made our experience great. He was an extremely thoughtful guide and made our chilly day on the water a fishy success. Recommend highly.
Booked two trips this week! Had a blast and got on fish. Learned alot from captain Devin. Highly recommend this charter you can't go wrong!! We did an inshore trip and also a deep sea 6hr trip
